arknights-jumptocontent: Label of the skip link that jumps to the page content.
arknights-drawer-toggle: Label of the button that opens the navigation drawer on small screens.
arknights-search-toggle: Label of the button that reveals the search box on small screens.
arknights-search-shortcut:
Keyboard shortcut hint displayed inside the search box. Usually should not be translated.
{{optional}}
arknights-theme-os: Label of the theme option that follows the operating system preference (option of {{msg-mw|arknights-appearance}} in the reading preferences).
arknights-theme-day: Label of the light theme (option of {{msg-mw|arknights-appearance}} in the reading preferences). In Arknights the light UI is the archive / dossier interface. Kept short: one of three segments in a narrow panel.
arknights-theme-night: Label of the dark theme (option of {{msg-mw|arknights-appearance}} in the reading preferences). In Arknights the dark UI is the PRTS terminal interface. Kept short: one of three segments in a narrow panel.
arknights-usermenu-toggle: Label of the button that opens the user menu.
arknights-usermenu-anon: Text shown on the user menu button for visitors who are not logged in.
arknights-usermenu-preferences: Heading of the user-menu section that holds interface preferences, such as the UniversalLanguageSelector language switcher. MediaWiki core has no message for the "user-interface-preferences" portlet, so the skin supplies its own.
arknights-toc-toggle: Label of the button that expands or collapses the subsections of a table of contents entry.
arknights-back-to-top: Label of the floating button that scrolls to the top of the page.
arknights-page-tools-more: Label of the dropdown holding additional page actions (move, delete, protect …).
arknights-variants-toggle: Label of the dropdown holding language variants.
arknights-shortlink: Accessible name (aria-label) of the icon-only link at the end of the page title that copies the short link of the current page.
arknights-shortlink-tooltip: Tooltip of the copy short link icon.
arknights-shortlink-copied: Replaces the accessible name and tooltip of the copy short link icon for a moment after the link was copied to the clipboard (the icon turns into a check mark; there is no notification).
arknights-shortlink-copy-failed: Notification shown when the browser refused to copy the short link. $1 is the URL, so that it can still be copied by hand.
arknights-languages-toggle: Label of the dropdown holding interlanguage links.
arknights-sidebar-label: Accessible label of the sidebar navigation region.
arknights-appearance:
Label of the colour theme group in the reading preferences (header panel and [[Special:ReadingPreferences]]).
{{Identical|Appearance}}
arknights-nav-screen: Accessible label of the header burger that pulls down the tools card (reading preferences, notifications, user menu) below 1120px.
arknights-prefs:
Label of the header icon (glasses) that opens the reading preferences panel, and heading of that panel.
{{Identical|Reading preferences}}
arknights-prefs-sections-on: Label of the reading preference that decides at which screen widths top-level section headings get a collapse toggle.
arknights-prefs-sections-on-mobile: Option of {{msg-mw|arknights-prefs-sections-on}}: only on narrow screens (phones, up to 639px). The default.
arknights-prefs-sections-on-all: Option of {{msg-mw|arknights-prefs-sections-on}}: at every screen width.
arknights-prefs-sections: Label of the reading preference that decides whether collapsible sections start expanded or collapsed when a page opens.
arknights-prefs-sections-expand: Option of {{msg-mw|arknights-prefs-sections}}: sections start expanded. The default.
arknights-prefs-font-size: Label of the reading preference for the text size of the article body (12 / 14 / 16 / 20px). The header, sidebar and table of contents keep their size.
arknights-prefs-font-size-xsmall: Smallest text size, 12px. Also used as the smaller option of {{msg-mw|arknights-prefs-table-font-size}}. Kept short: one of four segments in a narrow panel, each shown in its own size.
arknights-prefs-font-size-small: Text size 14px. Kept short: one of four segments in a narrow panel.
arknights-prefs-font-size-regular: Text size 16px, the default. Kept short: one of four segments in a narrow panel.
arknights-prefs-font-size-large: Text size 20px. Kept short: one of four segments in a narrow panel.
arknights-prefs-table-font-size: Label of the reading preference for the text size of tables, independent of the body text size.
arknights-prefs-table-font-size-auto: Option of {{msg-mw|arknights-prefs-table-font-size}}: tables follow the body text size. The default.
arknights-prefs-save:
Submit button of the reading preferences form on [[Special:ReadingPreferences]]. Only shown without JavaScript; with JavaScript a change applies at once.
{{Identical|Save}}
arknights-prefs-reset: Button on [[Special:ReadingPreferences]] that sets every reading preference back to its default.
arknights-prefs-return:
Link on [[Special:ReadingPreferences]] back to the page the visitor came from.
{{Identical|Back}}
arknights-prefs-saved: Shown on [[Special:ReadingPreferences]] after the form was submitted without JavaScript and saved.
arknights-prefs-anon-nojs: Error on [[Special:ReadingPreferences]] when a logged-out visitor submits the form without JavaScript: their preferences can only be kept in the browser (localStorage), which needs JavaScript.
arknights-header-tagline:
Short Latin tagline shown under the site name in the header and footer (e.g. "ARKNIGHTS WIKI"). Empty by default; wikis set it on-wiki via MediaWiki:Arknights-header-tagline.
{{optional}}
arknights-footer-powered:
Small print in the site footer.
{{optional}}
arknights-footer-about: Heading of the footer links column (privacy / about / disclaimers).
arknights-footer-desc:
Optional description paragraph in the site footer, parsed as wikitext in the content language. Disabled by default; wikis define MediaWiki:Arknights-footer-desc.
{{ignored}}
arknights-footer-tagline:
Optional tagline in the bottom bar of the site footer, parsed as wikitext in the content language. Disabled by default.
{{ignored}}
arknights-footer-links: Optional link columns in the site footer, in MediaWiki:Sidebar syntax (* heading / ** target|label), rendered before the about column. Disabled by default; wikis define MediaWiki:Arknights-footer-links. {{ignored}}
arknights-search-label: Accessible name of the search control and of the search palette dialog.
arknights-search-placeholder: Placeholder of the search field. $1 is the site name ({{SITENAME}}).
arknights-search-recent: Heading of the recently visited pages group, shown when the palette is opened with an empty query.
arknights-search-pages: Heading of the group holding ordinary title-search results.
arknights-search-modes: Heading of the list of command modes, shown after typing "/".
arknights-search-fulltext:
Label of the row that runs a full-text search. $1 is the query. Parameters:
* $1 - the text the user typed
arknights-search-fulltext-desc: Second line of the full-text search row.
arknights-search-empty-title: Title of the empty state, shown when the palette has no query and no recent pages.
arknights-search-empty-desc:
Description of the empty state. $1 is replaced by a rendered "/" key cap, so keep it inline. Parameters:
* $1 - the "/" key cap
arknights-search-shortcuts-label: Heading above the shortcut links in the empty state of the search palette.
arknights-search-shortcuts: Shortcut links offered in the empty state of the search palette, edited on-wiki at MediaWiki:Arknights-search-shortcuts. One * target|label per line, the item syntax of {{msg-mw|sidebar}} without the group headings; each half is a message key when such a message exists and a literal page name / URL / text otherwise. A line whose target or label resolves to - is skipped, and at most eight lines are used. Set the whole message to - to show no shortcuts at all. {{optional}}
arknights-search-noresults:
Shown when nothing matched. Parameters:
* $1 - the text the user typed
arknights-search-error: Shown when the search request failed.
arknights-search-results:
Screen-reader announcement of the result count. Parameters:
* $1 - number of results
arknights-search-redirect:
Note on a result reached through a redirect or an alternate name. Parameters:
* $1 - the title that matched
arknights-search-hint-navigate: Footer key hint for the arrow keys. Keep it short.
arknights-search-hint-open: Footer key hint for Enter. Keep it short.
arknights-search-hint-go: Footer key hint for Enter when no row is highlighted: Enter then runs MediaWiki's "Go" (exact title, else full-text results). Keep it short.
arknights-search-hint-fulltext: Footer key hint for Shift+Enter. Keep it short.
arknights-search-hint-close: Footer key hint for Escape when there is nothing to clear. Keep it short.
arknights-search-hint-clear: Footer key hint for Escape while the query is non-empty. Keep it short.
arknights-search-hint-back: Footer key hint for Escape while a command mode is active. Keep it short.
arknights-search-hint-commands: Label of the footer button that opens the command list. Keep it short.
arknights-search-close: Label of the button that closes the palette.
arknights-search-clear: Accessible name of the button that clears the query.
arknights-search-back: Accessible name of the button that leaves the active command mode.
arknights-search-remove: Accessible name of the button that drops one entry from the recent list.
arknights-search-mode-action: Name of the "actions" command mode, triggered by ">" or "/action".
arknights-search-mode-action-desc: Description of the actions mode in the command list.
arknights-search-mode-action-placeholder: Field placeholder while the actions mode is active.
arknights-search-mode-category: Name of the categories command mode, triggered by "#" or "/cat".
arknights-search-mode-category-desc: Description of the categories mode in the command list.
arknights-search-mode-category-placehold: Field placeholder while the categories mode is active.
arknights-search-mode-category-thispage: Note next to the group heading when the categories mode lists the current page's own categories.
arknights-search-mode-user: Name of the users command mode, triggered by "@" or "/user".
arknights-search-mode-user-desc: Description of the users mode in the command list.
arknights-search-mode-user-placeholder: Field placeholder while the users mode is active.
arknights-search-mode-file: Name of the files command mode, triggered by "~" or "/file".
arknights-search-mode-file-desc: Description of the files mode in the command list.
arknights-search-mode-file-placeholder: Field placeholder while the files mode is active.
arknights-search-group-operator: Default heading of the operators group in the local search index. Referenced from $wgArknightsSearchIndex.
arknights-search-group-item: Default heading of the items group in the local search index. Referenced from $wgArknightsSearchIndex.
arknights-search-load-error: Shown when the search palette module fails to load or times out after the user asked for it. The header search form keeps working, so this is a notice rather than an error.
